question: An electromagnetic wave is travelling along the positive x-direction. If its electric field oscillates along the positive y-direction, along which direction should its magnetic field oscillate?

options.A: The magnetic field oscillates along the $-x$-direction.
options.B: The magnetic field oscillates along the $+y$-direction, parallel to the electric field.
options.C: The magnetic field oscillates along the $-z$-direction.
options.D: For propagation along $+x$, $\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$ must be along $+x$. With $\vec{E}$ along $+y$, $\vec{B}$ must oscillate along $+z$ because $\hat{y} \times \hat{z} = \hat{x}$.
